why: Analysis 2's hedgehog (durable molded products for mass retail, profit per shelf-foot with profit per active SKU as proxy) and its choice of order fill as the weakest link sit closer to the key's SKU-level denominator and fix-fulfilment-first decision, while Analysis 1 centres on profit per pound of resin and pricing power. Both cover the 15% target, launch quotas, resin, retailer concentration and the Stage 1-5 decline path equally well, and Analysis 1 is somewhat richer on numbers, including catching the dossier's 9% versus 8.3% discrepancy.
